response.summary: The per-actor local store is solid. It is keyed by family:id, it never uses an anonymous bucket, it quarantines malformed data instead of overwriting it, and its save notices are honest. The aids are disabled on timed, sealed, practice-test and protected-review canvases. Crossing out no longer clears the chosen answer. Several edge cases still need fixing. Saved LR cross-outs carry over into later runs and can lock or hide choices there, including the student's own answer. Opening an RC bookmark creates a new drill session. RC has no explicit way to clear its saved cross-outs. Session-scoped RC cross-out keys pile up in storage with no limit. The RC cross-out write reads state from the current render, so rapid toggles can save the wrong set.

findings.evidence: eliminatedAnswers falls back to studyEliminationsFor(studyTools.state, {family:'lr', id: qid}), keyed only by the canonical qid, not by run. A cross-out from a drill weeks ago comes back in every later practice run of that question. OfficialQuestionPane:344 makes an eliminated choice locked (locked = isEliminated || ...), so a new run opens with choices pre-crossed and unclickable. When a resumed or adaptive run restores a selectedAnswer that is also in the saved set, the chosen letter shows as crossed out and locked. crossOutBlocked only covers isSelected && !isEliminated. This conflicts with the spec: 'never hide a chosen answer invisibly'.
findings.fix: When restoring, drop the selected letter from the saved set (or never treat a selected letter as eliminated in the pane). Consider scoping LR cross-outs to a run/session, as RC does, or show a visible 'restored from earlier' cue with one-click clear. Add a test where the selected letter is in the saved set.

findings.evidence: bookmarkHref for RC returns /rc/drill?passage=X&q=Y. RcPlayer.tsx:234-245 handles a passage param by calling createSession(DEFAULT_CONFIG, [passageId]), a database write. So every click on an RC bookmark (it opens a new tab) creates a fresh RC drill session row. A bookmark is meant to be a read-only aid, and the plan says retrieval must not write practice records.
findings.fix: State this in the UI/handoff, or route RC bookmarks to a read-only passage view or search destination (e.g. /rc/search) that does not create a session until the student starts it.

findings.evidence: RC passes hasMarks={false} and no onClearMarks, so RC has no 'clear current-question aids' action. rcCrossOutRef keys cross-outs by `${sessionId}:${questionId}`. These keys are never pruned when a session completes, so lsatu.studyTools.v1:<actor> keeps growing with dead session keys. MAX_BOOKMARKS caps only bookmarks. Eventually storage hits its quota and the app falsely reports 'Marks not saved' for everything.
findings.fix: Remove the session's cross-out keys when the session completes or is submitted, cap or LRU the eliminations map, and add an explicit clear for RC cross-outs on the current question.

findings.evidence: onToggleElimination works out `next` from state.eliminations captured in the render closure, separately from the reducer dispatch. Two toggles before a re-render (fast double tap or keyboard repeat) compute from the same stale base. The saved set then differs from the reducer's state and comes back wrong after a reload.
findings.fix: Work out the saved set from the reducer result: persist in an effect keyed on state.eliminations.get(questionId), or apply the same toggle function to studyTools.update's prev state.
